name: Kary Djedi
source:
Overly confident—but not moody or spiteful—Kary is happy as long as he can fool around, tell dirty jokes, and throw shade at others.

Officially speaking, he's part of a student exchange between Arcan and Anukaï.

Magic: Fire Elemental
Occupation: Student
Species: Human
